message:
And they look so adorable when they're kittens. "Let's get two," my husband said.  So now we have the early morning tag -team wake- up calls, too, at 4:30 and 5.
What amazes me about cat chases is that they become oblivious to anything in their way (like us, for one)while they thunder after each other.  It's so different from the surgeon-like precision with which they start pushing glass breakables toward the edge of a dresser just to get one's attention.
Good to hear that they're not screaming at each other.
